repairs.quote: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. Every 100 Hex Fragments Viktor obtains will permanently upgrade an active Ability. After upgrading all of his basic Abilities, Viktor can upgrade his Ultimate Ability. Killing minions grants 1 Hex Fragment. Killing cannon minions grants 10 Hex Fragments. Champion takedowns grant 20 Hex Fragments.
